dictionary.repo_read: Read repository files, git history, branches, logs (no write).
dictionary.edit_code: Modify source and test files under guarded scope (requires worktree + scope enforcement for safety floor).
dictionary.run_tests: Execute project test/build commands and interpret results (required for final integration Critic).
dictionary.dag_planning: Produce dependency DAG + per-task metadata (task_id, depends_on, file_ownership, parallelizable, risk_level, acceptance_criteria).
dictionary.file_ownership_prediction: Predict which files a task will touch (used for conflict-free parallel scheduling).
dictionary.architecture_design: Cross-cutting design: schemas, service/API boundaries, auth/event models, major refactors, test strategy. Produces ADRs/proposals.
dictionary.scope_audit: Verify edits stayed within declared file_ownership and role roots.
dictionary.integration_verification: Run full acceptance criteria + project test suite on a candidate merge; authoritative pass/fail for promotion.
dictionary.worktree: Operate inside a git worktree sandbox (enables parallel Coders without polluting main checkout).
dictionary.local_commit: Perform git add/commit inside an assigned worktree on the task branch (never on shared branches).

notes: Capabilities are declared by runtimes and required by tasks/handoffs. Routing is a pure function of (required_capabilities + enabled_runtimes + safety floor + preference rank).
